mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_MEMBER (MEMBER_ID, LOGIN_ID, PASSWORD, MEMBER_TYPE, NAME, PHONE, EMAIL, PHONE_VERIFIED, STATUS) VALUES (SEQ_MEMBER.NEXTVAL, #{loginId}, #{password}, #{memberType}, #{name}, #{phone}, #{email}, 'Y', 'ACTIVE')
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_MEMBER WHERE LOGIN_ID = #{loginId}
SELECT * FROM TB_MEMBER WHERE LOGIN_ID = #{loginId} AND STATUS != 'WITHDRAWN'
SELECT LOGIN_ID FROM TB_MEMBER WHERE NAME = #{name} AND PHONE = #{phone} AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
